words.Example_EN_1: What do you do on weekends?
I watch TV in the evening
My spouse works in Tel Aviv
words.Example_HE_1: בן הזוג שלי עובד בתל אביב

words.Example_EN_1: I have a craving for chocolate
I need to get enough sleep
I need to retire from work
I was embarrassed when I fell in the street.
words.Example_EN_2: She felt embarrassed about her English.
words.Example_HE_2: היא הרגישה נבוכה בגלל האנגלית שלה.
words.Collocation: be embarrassed about / be embarrassed to + verb
words.CommonMistake_HE: נבוך (אתה) ≠ מביך (המצב). embarrassed = אתה נבוך, embarrassing = המצב מביך. אל תגיד I am embarrassing!

words.Example_EN_1: Although it was raining, we went to Jerusalem.
words.Example_EN_2: Although I'm tired, I will study.
words.CommonMistake_HE: אל תגיד Although but - זה או Although או But, לא שניהם! Although it was raining but we went = שגיאה
words.Mnemonic_HE: ALL + THOUGH = למרות ש-כל זה קרה...

words.Example_EN_1: She worked hard to achieve her dream.
words.Example_HE_1: היא עבדה קשה כדי להגשים את החלום שלה.
words.Example_EN_2: We can achieve great results together.
words.Example_HE_2: אנחנו יכולים להשיג תוצאות נהדרות ביחד.
words.Collocation: achieve a goal / dream / success / results
words.CommonMistake_HE: achieve = פועל (להשיג), achievement = שם עצם (הישג). אל תגיד I have achieve

words.Example_EN_1: I am proud of my son.
words.Example_EN_2: We are proud to be Israeli.
words.CommonMistake_HE: proud = גאה (תואר), pride = גאווה (שם עצם). proud OF, לא proud FROM
words.Mnemonic_HE: PRO כמו מקצוען - גאה כמו PRO

words.Example_EN_1: He felt nervous before the interview.
words.Example_EN_2: Don't be nervous, you will do great!
words.Example_HE_2: אל תהיה לחוץ, אתה תהיה נהדר!
words.Collocation: nervous about / before / be nervous to + verb
words.CommonMistake_HE: nervous = לחוץ לפני אירוע, לא עצבני במובן כועס (angry). I'm nervous before test = אני לחוץ

words.Example_EN_1: She is confident about her English.
words.Example_EN_2: Be confident, you know the material!
words.Example_HE_2: תהיה בטוח בעצמך, אתה מכיר את החומר!
words.Collocation: confident about / in / confident that + clause
words.CommonMistake_HE: confident = בטוח בעצמך, לא בטוח ש... (sure). I'm confident about = אני בטוח בעצמי ב...

words.Example_EN_1: I was disappointed with my grade.
words.Example_EN_2: She was disappointed that he didn't come.
words.Collocation: disappointed with / in / about / that + clause
words.CommonMistake_HE: disappointed = אתה מאוכזב, disappointing = מאכזב (הדבר). The movie was disappointing, I was disappointed

words.Example_HE_1: אני אסיר תודה על העזרה שלך.
words.Example_EN_2: We are grateful to have you as a teacher.
words.Example_HE_2: אנחנו אסירי תודה שיש לנו אותך כמורה.
words.Collocation: grateful for something / grateful to someone
words.CommonMistake_HE: grateful = אסיר תודה עמוקה ורצינית, יותר מ-thankful. grateful FOR עזרה, grateful TO אדם

words.Example_EN_1: She felt anxious about her health.
words.Example_HE_1: היא הרגישה חרדה לגבי הבריאות שלה.
words.Collocation: anxious about / anxious to + verb (רוצה מאוד) / anxious that
words.CommonMistake_HE: anxious חזק מ-nervous. nervous = לחוץ לפני מבחן, anxious = חרדה אמיתית. anxious to = משתוקק, לא רק חרד

words.Example_EN_2: I'm curious to know what happened in Jerusalem.
words.Example_HE_2: אני סקרן לדעת מה קרה בירושלים.
words.CommonMistake_HE: curious = סקרן (חיובי), לא מוזר! strange = מוזר. I'm curious = אני סקרן

words.Example_EN_1: He was jealous of his friend's new car.
words.Example_HE_1: הוא קינא במכונית החדשה של חברו.
words.Example_EN_2: Don't be jealous, you can achieve it too!
words.Example_HE_2: אל תקנא, גם אתה יכול להשיג את זה!
words.CommonMistake_HE: jealous OF, לא jealous FROM. jealous = קנאה ברכוש, envious דומה אבל jealous גם חשד בבגידה

words.Example_EN_1: I was relieved when I found my keys.
words.Example_EN_2: She felt relieved after the exam.
words.Collocation: relieved that / when / to + verb / relieved about
words.CommonMistake_HE: relieved = חש הקלה, לא released = שוחרר. I was relieved = הוקל לי

words.Example_EN_1: I feel frustrated when my internet is slow.
words.Example_EN_2: He was frustrated with his English progress.
words.Collocation: frustrated with / by / about / frustrated that
words.CommonMistake_HE: frustrated = אתה מתוסכל, frustrating = מתסכל (המצב). The lesson is frustrating, I am frustrated

words.Example_EN_1: We were amazed by the view of Jerusalem.
words.Example_EN_2: I was amazed to hear her story.
words.Collocation: amazed by / at / to + verb / amazed that
words.CommonMistake_HE: amazed = אתה נדהם, amazing = מדהים. The view is amazing, I am amazed
words.Mnemonic_HE: A-MAZED = הולך לאיבוד במבוך של הפתעה

words.Example_EN_1: After the hike in the desert, we were exhausted.
words.CommonMistake_HE: exhausted = מותש לגמרי, חזק מ-tired. tired = עייף, exhausted = אין כוח לזוז
words.Mnemonic_HE: EX-HAUSTED = רוקנת את כל האוויר, סחוט

words.Example_EN_1: She was thrilled to get the job in Tel Aviv.
words.Example_HE_1: היא הייתה נרגשת מאוד לקבל את העבודה בתל אביב.
words.Example_EN_2: We were thrilled about our trip to Israel.
words.Example_HE_2: היינו נרגשים מאוד לגבי הטיול לישראל.
words.Collocation: thrilled about / to + verb / thrilled that / thrilled with
words.CommonMistake_HE: thrilled = נרגש מאוד, חזק מ-excited. thrilled זה שיא ההתרגשות!

words.Example_EN_1: He felt ashamed of his behavior.
words.Example_EN_2: You should be ashamed of lying!
words.Collocation: ashamed of / ashamed to + verb / ashamed that
words.CommonMistake_HE: ashamed = בושה מוסרית עמוקה, embarrassed = מבוכה רגעית. ashamed of what you did = בושה במעשה

words.Example_EN_1: I felt overwhelmed by all the homework.
words.Example_EN_2: She was overwhelmed with emotions in Jerusalem.
words.Collocation: overwhelmed by / with / overwhelmed to + verb
words.CommonMistake_HE: overwhelmed = מוצף רגשית, לא overcame = התגבר. overwhelmed BY work = מוצף מעבודה

words.Example_EN_1: The story of Jerusalem inspired me to learn more.
words.Example_HE_1: הסיפור של ירושלים נתן לי השראה ללמוד יותר.
words.Example_EN_2: I felt inspired after the lesson.
words.CommonMistake_HE: inspired = אתה מלא השראה, inspiring = נותן השראה. She is inspiring, I am inspired

words.Example_EN_1: He felt content with his simple life.
words.Example_EN_2: I'm content to stay home today.
words.Collocation: content with / content to + verb / content that
words.CommonMistake_HE: content (adj) = מרוצה - מבטאים kənTENT, content (noun) = תוכן - KONtent. שני פירושים שונים!
words.Mnemonic_HE: CONTENT = תוכן מספק, מסופק ממה שיש
